The ShelterKart Home Buying Guide

Our Principles

This text is available in English only. The English version governs.

No developer can pay to add, change, or remove any finding, question, or part of a report.

Every claim on a report traces to a specific public source, graded by how well it is supported: confirmed at an official source, reported by several independent sites, resting on a single source, or the developer’s own claim. We never present an unverified claim with the confidence of a verified one.

Where we don’t have reliable public data, we say so plainly rather than filling the gap with a plausible-sounding guess.

Payment unlocks the full findings and the source trail. It never changes a finding.

Report an inaccuracy

We review every dispute against the original source document. Submission does not guarantee removal or alteration of any finding — see Terms.

How a report is built

This text is available in English only. The English version governs.

A report is built from public sources. Every finding links to the page it came from and shows the date that page was read.

What every report answers

The developer. Its other projects, and what the public record says about them.

The project. Registration, approvals, dates and progress, as the official sources state them.

Legal standing. Any official register entry, court record or regulator action we can find.

What buyers say. Themes that recur across independent reviews, forums and social media, shown as what people say, not as fact.

What the developer discloses. The facts the developer publishes itself, marked as the developer’s own claim.

How each finding is marked

Each finding shows how well it is supported: confirmed at an official source, reported by several independent sites, resting on a single source, or the developer’s own claim. Where sources disagree, each version is shown side by side.

What we do not do

We do not fill a gap with a guess. What could not be found is said so plainly, with who to ask. We do not sum a project up in a number, and a report never says whether to buy.

The developer’s reply

Any developer may reply to any finding. The reply appears beside the finding and never replaces it.

Checkout

Unlock the full report

Why this price? It depends on the value of the property and how much evidence this report holds. It is the same for every buyer, shown in your currency.

Every finding with its sources, what each disagreement says, how each finding is marked, every question to ask, every page checked, and the PDF.

Developer Right of Reply

Free and unconditional. See our Constitution. Nothing here can change a finding; your response is reviewed, then published alongside the finding it responds to, never in place of it.

1. Nature of the Service

ShelterKart ("the Service") provides informational research reports and, compiled from publicly available sources including regulatory, corporate and open-data records. The Service is provided for general informational purposes only and does not constitute legal, financial, tax, investment, or real estate advice of any kind.

2. Scope of Coverage

The Service covers primary sales of residential and commercial property directly from a developer or builder only. It does not cover resale or secondary-market transactions, land, plots, or any transaction between private individual owners. Use of the Service for any purpose outside this stated scope is outside its intended design and undertaken entirely at the user’s own risk.

3. No Brokerage, Agency, or Advisory Relationship

ShelterKart does not act as a real estate agent, broker, dealer, or intermediary in any transaction, does not receive commission on any property sale, and does not facilitate, negotiate, or execute any transaction between a user and any developer or third party. No fiduciary, advisory, agency, partnership, or employment relationship is created between the user and ShelterKart by use of the Service.

4. No Warranty on Accuracy or Completeness

Regulatory data can change without notice; the "as of" date on any report reflects only the date of compilation, not real-time status.

5. Reports Are Information, Not a Guarantee

Privacy Policy

This text is available in English only. The English version governs.

What we collect

Your searches. The property or developer name, city and market you search. Searches are not linked to your identity. Before a search leaves our servers, anything that looks like a phone number or email address is removed from it.

Documents you choose to check. If you upload an allotment letter, agreement or certificate, it is read once to extract six property details: the project name, registration numbers, selling company, possession date, payment bank and document type. Your personal details are not extracted. The file is not stored, logged or cached.

Payments. Payments are handled by Razorpay. We never see or store your card, UPI or bank details. We keep a purchase record: the report reference, amount, currency, status, and Razorpay’s order and payment references.

Access to a report you bought. A signed access code for that report is kept in your browser on this device, so the report opens again when you return. On another device, you can restore it with the payment ID from your Razorpay receipt.

Contact details. If you choose to give us a phone number or email address, it is used only for the purpose you gave it for, and only after your explicit consent.

Who processes it for us

Anthropic, which provides the AI model that runs the research and reads uploaded documents. Razorpay, which processes payments. Public websites and official registers receive requests from our servers when research runs; they never receive your identity.

Visit statistics. We count visits to understand how people find ShelterKart: the page, the website or campaign link that brought you, the country your connection comes from, whether you use a phone or a computer, and actions such as searching, unlocking a report, saving a PDF or sharing one. We use no cookies for this and store no IP address. To count unique visitors, we use a code that changes every day, so it cannot identify you or connect your visits on different days. The names of projects searched are recorded, with phone numbers and email addresses removed.

What we do not do

We do not sell personal data. We do not use your details for marketing you did not ask for. No developer can pay to see who searched for their projects.

How long we keep it

Reports are kept for up to 30 days, so a shared link or a report you bought keeps working. They contain no personal details: phone numbers and email addresses are removed from searches, and no report records who searched. After 30 days they are deleted. Uploaded documents are not kept at all. Visit statistics are kept for 400 days. Purchase records are kept as long as tax and payment law requires.

Your rights

You can ask what we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it, by writing to corrections@shelterkart.com.
